premise: Seal wonders whether big Pelican can swim; he sits down on the water and floats like a cork, because his feathers and even his bones are full of air.
inspiration: The 'can you…?' dare of folk tales (the animal who is doubted) answered calmly: he just shows her, and the two best floaters bob together.
learning: Pelicans float on the water like corks, because they are full of air.

en-US.title: Pelican Floats
en-US.text: {pelican:enter} {pelican:go to rocks} Pelican stood on the rocks, looking at the water. {pelican:live scoop} He scooped up a beakful, and gulped. {seal:enter by swim} Seal popped up below. {seal:wobble} [curious] Pelican, can you swim? {pelican:face happy} Pelican smiled. Watch, he said. {pelican:go to sea by float} Down he flapped, and sat on the water, light as a feather. He bobbed. He floated. He didn't sink one bit. {seal:face surprised} {seal:hop} [in awe] How do you DO that? asked Seal. {pelican:float loop 0.3} My feathers are full of air, said Pelican. Even my bones have air inside. So I float like a cork! {ring:enter} {ring:go to sea} Just then the rubber ring came bobbing past. {ring:live spin} It turned slowly round. [laughs] {seal:face happy} {seal:live laugh} Look! said Seal. You float just like the ring! {pelican:hearts} {ring:pulse} [softly] {ring:go to pelican} And there they bobbed, side by side, Pelican and the ring, the two best floaters around.

es-ES.title: Pelícano flota
es-ES.text: {pelican:enter} {pelican:go to rocks} Pelícano estaba en las rocas, mirando el agua. {pelican:live scoop} Recogió un buen trago con el pico, y se lo tragó. {seal:enter by swim} Foca asomó por debajo. {seal:wobble} [curious] Pelícano, ¿tú sabes nadar? {pelican:face happy} Pelícano sonrió. Mira, dijo. {pelican:go to sea by float} Bajó aleteando, y se sentó en el agua, ligero como una pluma. Se mecía. Flotaba. No se hundía ni un poquito. {seal:face surprised} {seal:hop} [in awe] ¿Cómo lo HACES?, preguntó Foca. {pelican:float loop 0.3} Mis plumas están llenas de aire, dijo Pelícano. Hasta mis huesos tienen aire dentro. ¡Por eso floto como un corcho! {ring:enter} {ring:go to sea} En ese momento pasó el flotador, meciéndose. {ring:live spin} Giró despacito. [laughs] {seal:face happy} {seal:live laugh} ¡Mira!, dijo Foca. ¡Flotas igual que el flotador! {pelican:hearts} {ring:pulse} [softly] {ring:go to pelican} Y allí se quedaron, meciéndose uno al lado del otro, Pelícano y el flotador, los mejores flotadores de por aquí.

ja-JP.title: ぷかぷか ペリカンくん
ja-JP.text: {pelican:enter}{pelican:go to rocks}ペリカンくんは、岩の上にたって、水を見ていました。{pelican:live scoop}くちばしで水をすくって、ごくん。{seal:enter by swim}アザラシさんが、下からひょっこり。{seal:wobble}[curious]「ペリカンくん、およげるの？」 {pelican:face happy}ペリカンくんは、にっこり。「見ててごらん」 {pelican:go to sea by float}ぱたぱたとおりて、水の上に、ふわりとすわりました。はねみたいに、かるがると。ぷかぷか。ゆらゆら。ちっとも、しずみません。{seal:face surprised}{seal:hop}[in awe]「どうやったら、そんなふうにできるの？」 とアザラシさん。{pelican:float loop 0.3}「ぼくのはねには、空気がいっぱい。ほねのなかにも、空気が入っているんだ。だから、ぷかーっとうくのさ！」 {ring:enter}{ring:go to sea}ちょうどそこへ、うきわが、ぷかぷかながれてきました。{ring:live spin}ゆっくり、くるり。[laughs]{seal:face happy}{seal:live laugh}「見て！うきわと、おんなじだね！」 とアザラシさん。{pelican:hearts}{ring:pulse}[softly]{ring:go to pelican}そうして、ならんでぷかぷか。ペリカンくんとうきわは、このあたりでいちばんの、ぷかぷかめいじんです。

de-DE.title: Der Pelikan schwimmt oben
de-DE.text: {pelican:enter} {pelican:go to rocks} Der Pelikan stand auf den Felsen und schaute aufs Wasser. {pelican:live scoop} Er schöpfte einen Schnabel voll und schluckte. {seal:enter by swim} Die Robbe tauchte unter ihm auf. {seal:wobble} [curious] „Pelikan, kannst du schwimmen?“ {pelican:face happy} Der Pelikan lächelte. „Pass auf“, sagte er. {pelican:go to sea by float} Er flatterte hinunter und setzte sich aufs Wasser, leicht wie eine Feder. Er schaukelte. Er trieb dahin. Er ging kein bisschen unter. {seal:face surprised} {seal:hop} [in awe] „Wie MACHST du das?“, fragte die Robbe. {pelican:float loop 0.3} „Meine Federn sind voller Luft“, sagte der Pelikan. „Sogar in meinen Knochen ist Luft. Darum schwimme ich oben wie ein Korken!“ {ring:enter} {ring:go to sea} Genau da kam der Schwimmring vorbeigeschaukelt. {ring:live spin} Er drehte sich langsam im Kreis. [laughs] {seal:face happy} {seal:live laugh} „Guck mal!“, sagte die Robbe. „Du schwimmst ja genau wie der Ring!“ {pelican:hearts} {ring:pulse} [softly] {ring:go to pelican} Und da schaukelten sie nebeneinander, der Pelikan und der Ring, die zwei besten Korken weit und breit.

fr-FR.title: Pélican flotte comme un bouchon
fr-FR.text: {pelican:enter} {pelican:go to rocks} Pélican se tenait sur les rochers, et il regardait l’eau. {pelican:live scoop} Il en a pris une grosse becquée, et gloups, il l’a avalée. {seal:enter by swim} Phoque a surgi juste en dessous. {seal:wobble} [curious] « Pélican, tu sais nager, toi ? » {pelican:face happy} Pélican a souri. « Regarde bien », a-t-il dit. {pelican:go to sea by float} Il est descendu en battant des ailes, et il s’est assis sur l’eau, léger comme une plume. Il se balançait. Il flottait. Il ne coulait pas du tout ! {seal:face surprised} {seal:hop} [in awe] « Mais comment tu FAIS ? » a demandé Phoque. {pelican:float loop 0.3} « Mes plumes sont pleines d’air, a dit Pélican. Même mes os ont de l’air dedans. Alors je flotte comme un bouchon ! » {ring:enter} {ring:go to sea} Juste à ce moment-là, la bouée est passée en se dandinant sur l’eau. {ring:live spin} Elle a tourné tout doucement. [laughs] {seal:face happy} {seal:live laugh} « Regarde ! a dit Phoque. Tu flottes exactement comme la bouée ! » {pelican:hearts} {ring:pulse} [softly] {ring:go to pelican} Et ils sont restés là, côte à côte, à se balancer sur l’eau, Pélican et la bouée, les deux meilleurs flotteurs de toute la baie.

it-IT.title: Pellicano galleggia
it-IT.text: {pelican:enter} {pelican:go to rocks} Pellicano se ne stava sugli scogli, a guardare l'acqua. {pelican:live scoop} Ha raccolto un bel sorso col becco, e glu, l'ha mandato giù. {seal:enter by swim} Foca è spuntata lì sotto. {seal:wobble} [curious] «Pellicano, tu sai nuotare?» {pelican:face happy} Pellicano ha sorriso. «Guarda», ha detto. {pelican:go to sea by float} È sceso giù sbattendo le ali, e si è posato sull'acqua, leggero come una piuma. Dondolava. Galleggiava. Non andava a fondo neanche un pochino. {seal:face surprised} {seal:hop} [in awe] «Ma come FAI?», ha chiesto Foca. {pelican:float loop 0.3} «Le mie piume sono piene d'aria», ha detto Pellicano. «Anche dentro le mie ossa c'è aria. Così galleggio come un tappo!» {ring:enter} {ring:go to sea} Proprio allora è passato il salvagente, dondolando. {ring:live spin} Ha fatto un giro lento lento. [laughs] {seal:face happy} {seal:live laugh} «Guarda!», ha detto Foca. «Galleggi proprio come il salvagente!» {pelican:hearts} {ring:pulse} [softly] {ring:go to pelican} E sono rimasti lì a dondolare, uno accanto all'altro, Pellicano e il salvagente, i più bravi a galleggiare di tutta la baia.

zh-TW.title: 鵜鶘會游泳嗎？
zh-TW.text: {pelican:enter}{pelican:go to rocks}鵜鶘站在岩石上，看著水面。{pelican:live scoop}牠舀起滿滿一嘴的水，咕嚕一聲吞下去。{seal:enter by swim}海豹從水裡冒出頭來。{seal:wobble}[curious]「鵜鶘，你會游泳嗎？」 {pelican:face happy}鵜鶘笑了。「你看好喔。」 牠說。{pelican:go to sea by float}牠拍拍翅膀飛下去，坐在水面上，輕得像一根羽毛。牠搖呀搖，漂呀漂，一點也沒有沉下去。{seal:face surprised}{seal:hop}[in awe]「你是怎麼辦到的？」 海豹問。{pelican:float loop 0.3}「我的羽毛裡面都是空氣，」 鵜鶘說，「連骨頭裡面也有空氣。所以，我就像軟木塞一樣，浮在水上！」 {ring:enter}{ring:go to sea}就在這時候，游泳圈一搖一晃地漂過來。{ring:live spin}它慢慢地轉了一圈。[laughs]{seal:face happy}{seal:live laugh}「你看！」 海豹說，「你浮得跟游泳圈一模一樣！」 {pelican:hearts}{ring:pulse}[softly]{ring:go to pelican}就這樣，鵜鶘和游泳圈並排漂呀漂，是這附近最會浮的兩個好朋友。

zh-HK.title: 鵜鶘浮浮浮
zh-HK.text: {pelican:enter}{pelican:go to rocks}鵜鶘站在岩石上，望着水面。{pelican:live scoop}牠舀起一大口水，咕嚕一聲吞了下去。{seal:enter by swim}海豹從下面的水裏冒出頭來。{seal:wobble}[curious]「鵜鶘，你識唔識游水㗎？」 {pelican:face happy}鵜鶘笑了笑。「睇住！」 {pelican:go to sea by float}牠拍拍翅膀飛下去，輕輕坐在水面上，輕得像一根羽毛。牠一浮一浮，漂呀漂，一點也沒有沉下去。{seal:face surprised}{seal:hop}[in awe]「你點做到㗎？」 海豹問。{pelican:float loop 0.3}「我啲羽毛入面全部都係空氣，」 鵜鶘說，「連骨頭入面都有空氣，所以我浮得好似個波咁！」 {ring:enter}{ring:go to sea}就在這時，水泡一浮一浮地漂過來。{ring:live spin}它慢慢地轉了一圈。[laughs]{seal:face happy}{seal:live laugh}「睇！」 海豹說，「你同水泡浮得一模一樣！」 {pelican:hearts}{ring:pulse}[softly]{ring:go to pelican}於是，牠們並排浮着，一浮一浮：鵜鶘和水泡，這裏最厲害的兩位浮水冠軍。
